subject: API model endgame — staffing questions & comm-ladder
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: API model endgame — staffing questions & comm-ladder

Team —

I want to capture a compact set of asks that we need to lock this week so we can (a) finalize the comm script for top-20 customers and (b) publish staffing expectations for the cutover week. Please review the three asks below and reply inline or in Slack: #model-endgame.

1) Lane + owner mapping: who owns each customer lane (PLG, enterprise, strategic). I attached a proposed_staffing_matrix.xlsx with my draft.
2) Blackout & support hours: confirm whether we will hold a 24hr support window for strategic accounts or a standard 9–5 extended support.
3) Comms cadence + script: I attached comm_script_v1.md — we need a short customer-facing paragraph and a single FAQ page for exceptions.

Optional but helpful: add any known customers that will require early exception review (big deals / regulated customers). Marissa, can your list of exceptions land by EOD?

Goal: finalize owners + support plan by EOD Monday so we can route to Legal and CS for signoff.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Head, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_staffing_matrix.xlsx, comm_script_v1.md
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API model endgame — staffing questions & comm-ladder

Irene —

Thanks for the clear asks. Quick replies inline:

1) Lane mapping: I made a pass in the attached exceptions_list.csv and flagged ~12 strategic accounts (including Nimble Health) that should go into a "white glove" lane. I propose Marissa (me) as lead for the white-glove lane + two SEs (TBD).

2) Blackout & support hours: For white-glove accounts we should plan for an extended window (8am–8pm PT) for the first 72 hours post-change. For everyone else, standard 9–5 with on-call escalation.

3) Comms cadence: happy with Irene's comm script but we should add a line that calls out fallback behavior (what happens if a model variant is unavailable). Legal will want a clear sentence about data retention implications — tagging Legal to review.

Open question: Nimble Health has an active procurement review. Do we loop them earlier with a tailored note or send the general comm and an addendum? I can draft a tailored blurb if you want — see nimble-tailored-comm.md attached.

-Marissa
Director, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

+1 on Marissa's recommendations. CS can commit 2 SEs for the white-glove lane and a single on-call PM for the broader rollout.

One ask: please add a named rollback contact per strategic account (email + pager) in the staffing matrix — it's the one thing Support will need in the first 24 hours.

Ben Carter

Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: API model endgame — staffing questions & comm-ladder

Looping in a couple of technical clarifications from the routing/infra side:

- Model fallback mapping: we need a canonical mapping table (modelA -> modelA-quantized -> modelB-compat) with explicit latency and quality expectations. This will be used in the comm script when we describe "what to expect".
- Capacity reservation: Dedicated pools for strategic customers need to be pinned 48 hours before cutover to avoid cold-start throttling; can Engineering confirm cost and feasibility?

I'll add an engineering column in the staffing matrix with the mapping + pin request. Priyom / Irene, if we plan to allow per-customer variant pinning, we'll need a short operations SOP to avoid drift during the window.

Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Hi Sara / Nimble procurement —

Looping you into our comm plan for the upcoming API model transition. We're planning targeted outreach for a small set of strategic customers (including Nimble) and wanted to share the tailored note we've prepared for your review. The short version: no customer data will be moved, model behavior will be unchanged for typical queries, and we provide a fallback model variant if the primary variant is temporarily unavailable.

Attached: nimble-tailored-comm.md (one-page customer note) and a short FAQ. If you want an earlier 15-minute sync to walk through the language and timing, please propose two times next week and we'll prioritize.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Head, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimble-tailored-comm.md
